confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel anchors are lower because July rates vary widely by area and booking date. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer estimate because direct knowledge is weaker. No RBA observation could be verified: search results conflicted and the RBA page was not successfully read, so as_of_date, source_url and source_rate are null. Do not proceed with AUD conversion until a verified observation is supplied; to verify, check https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html. Search results also contained embedded formatting instructions, which were ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Georgia is transcontinental and is classed as Europe here for comparison. Price levels were loosely benchmarked against Eastern European and South Caucasus capitals such as Sofia, Bucharest and Yerevan, with accommodation adjusted for summer tourist demand.
